mentions.name: Tailstream
mentions.description: Real-time log visualization platform with wallboard/TV support, inspired by Logstalgia. It provides a public backend API usable by any client, plus an open source agent written in Go that makes setup easy. A proper log viewer, alerts, and further visualization improvements are in development.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on real-time log visualization platform with wallboard/tv support, initially inspired by Logstalgia:

https://tailstream.io

Launched the initial version a couple of weeks ago and making good progress, trying to share as much of the process as I can on X.

Backend API can be used by any client, but I also built an open source agent in Go that makes setup really easy.
